audit.title: OpenClaw product reconciliation audit - current approved SkilzVolt skills (non-cartoon scope)
audit.authority: Current SkilzVolt catalogue and version-pinned skill bodies fetched during this audit
audit.coverage: 27 included non-cartoon skills audited to completion; 5 cartoon skills excluded by owner instruction
audit.bodyAssembly: All 32 assigned version-pinned bodies fetched through complete continuation chunks; code-point lengths validated.
audit.securityWarningPolicy: Unique live security warnings were surfaced before content review. Warned bodies are not treated as unconditionally trusted; warning status is recorded per row.

proofStandard: A declared schedule/cron phrase is not proof of a live scheduler.
Runtime activation requires source event -> router/tool -> executor -> destination -> readback/receipt.
Generic/manual skills are not failed for lacking invented local modules; they are marked not_product_runtime when no product-owned route is claimed or required.
A missing dedicated module or worker is not itself a contradiction for a procedural/model/manual skill; do not infer a product-runtime requirement from absence alone.
External attached_assets scripts are repository evidence only; deployment and live state are unverified.
sourceInventory: src/agents/openclaw-tools.ts:149-161; generic scheduler execution has no live state in checkout
globalBlockers: No live scheduler/cron records, worker state, gateway/node state, delivery receipts or external destination readback were available.
SkilzVolt extension injects metadata and exposes generic owner-only describe/call; it does not install each current remote body as a local executable skill.
Tracked attached_assets integrations may represent deployable/manual scripts, but their deployed status is not proven.

prioritizedRepairs.repair: Clarify briefing ownership and keep the weekly RSS sidecar explicitly separate; only add a product-owned route/readback if the briefing contract is intended to be product runtime. Do not infer a dedicated worker from an absent module.

Verify calendar-send is invoked through the generic exec.run approval/TOTP gate at src/infra/outbound/trust-gate.ts:227-295 and the installer configuration at attached_assets/install-forked-openclaw.sh:465-468,501-519; then verify exact command, account/attendee confirmation and Graph/log readback. Missing per-script TOTP is not itself a bypass.

For skills that explicitly claim schedules, verify whether product ownership exists via scheduler, execution and delivery observability; do not create dedicated workers solely because no module is tracked.

Where product runtime is intentionally claimed for manual artifact skills, register approved templates/resources and destination/readback checks (deck, timeline, anonymiser, scorecard, reports); otherwise retain the procedural/manual classification.
Keep warning-marked skills behind owner review and document scanner findings/mitigations before any writes or external delivery.
